load_object_detection_model_hub: load a pretrained object detection model from Hugging Face Hub and wrap it for ExecuTorch export
load_object_detection_model_local: load a local object detection model from disk path and prepare it for ExecuTorch lowering
load_object_detection_with_image_size: load an object detection model with a required image_size parameter for export to ExecuTorch
load_object_detection_with_channels: load an object detection model with custom num_channels configuration for export
register_object_detection_task: register an object detection model loading function under the task name object-detection using the register_task decorator
